idea.title: The 3 AM fridge light
idea.summary: A relatable 3 AM ritual of standing in the fridge light with nothing to do, where a stranger is also awake and doing the same thing; opens on a question, not a hook.
hookOptions: 3 AM. You're standing at the open fridge.
I've opened the fridge 4 times. I'm not hungry.
Who's awake at 3 AM? Me. Why?

scenes.question: 3 AM, wide awake. What do you do?
scenes.say: Be honest, you've done both tonight.

scenes.say: Your friends are asleep. Somebody else isn't.
